## [August 21, 2026](https://deepnote.com/changelog/2026-08-21)


#


[Build with Deepnote Agent, ship apps from the API, & more](https://deepnote.com/changelog/2026-08-21#build-with-deepnote-agent-ship-apps-from-the-api--more)


##


[Use Deepnote Agent with 90% off GPT-5.6 Sol](https://deepnote.com/changelog/2026-08-21#use-deepnote-agent-with-90-off-gpt-56-sol)


Deepnote Agent is available in your workspace, with full context of your project’s integrations or notebooks. To mark this release, AI usage in Deepnote is discounted by 90% until September 8. Give it a try!


##


[API & MCP updates](https://deepnote.com/changelog/2026-08-21#api--mcp-updates)


- **Publish Streamlit apps**


You can now build & publish[Streamlit apps](https://deepnote.com/docs/streamlit) through the API via` POST /v2/streamlit-apps` .


- **Export and import entire projects**


Two new endpoints make it easier to move, back up, and update complete projects:


` GET /v2/projects/{projectId}/export` downloads a project as a ZIP.


` POST /v2/projects/{projectId}/import` merges the ZIP into an existing project, including notebook changes, project renames, and integrations. You can revert changes thanks to conflict protection and an undo snapshot.


- **Work with folders**


Look up folders[through API or MCP](https://deepnote.com/docs/deepnote-api) via` list_folders` .Full details in the[Deepnote API docs](https://deepnote.com/docs/deepnote-api) .


- **Rename notebooks programmatically**


The new` PATCH /v2/notebooks/{notebookId}` endpoint lets users and agents[rename notebooks](https://deepnote.com/docs/deepnote-api) without opening the Deepnote interface.


##


[Build custom apps on top of notebooks](https://deepnote.com/changelog/2026-08-21#build-custom-apps-on-top-of-notebooks)


Introducing` @deepnote/local-runner` :[an open-source toolkit](https://github.com/deepnote/deepnote/tree/main/packages/local-runner?utm_source=brevo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=Use%20Deepnote%20Agent%20with%2090%20off%20AI%20usage%20%20start%20with%20a%20single%20notebook&utm_id=143) for turning local or cloud Deepnote notebooks into simple custom apps. Let users enter inputs, run the notebook, and inspect outputs like tables and charts. Saves time from having to build the connection between a custom interface and a Deepnote notebook.


##


[VS Code extension v1.6.0](https://deepnote.com/changelog/2026-08-21#vs-code-extension-v160)


Multi-notebook` .deepnote` files can now be split into separate files for each notebook. Files are grouped by project, making larger projects easier to navigate and manage in Git.
